import frappe

# Cek email account settings
email_accounts = frappe.db.get_list\("Email Account", fields=["name", "email_id", "enable_incoming", "default_incoming", "enable_outgoing", "default_outgoing", "email_server", "use_imap", "imap_folder"]\)

print\("=== EMAIL ACCOUNT SETTINGS ==="\)
for acc in email_accounts:
    print\(f"\\nName: {acc.get\('name'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Email: {acc.get\('email_id'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Enable Incoming: {acc.get\('enable_incoming'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Default Incoming: {acc.get\('default_incoming'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Enable Outgoing: {acc.get\('enable_outgoing'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Default Outgoing: {acc.get\('default_outgoing'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Email Server \(IMAP\): {acc.get\('email_server'\)}"\)
    print\(f"Use IMAP: {acc.get\('use_imap'\)}"\)

# Cek IMAP folders
print\("\\n=== IMAP FOLDERS ==="\)
try:
    folders = frappe.db.get_all\("Email Account Folder", fields=["parent", "folder_name", "append_to"]\)
    for folder in folders:
        print\(f"Email: {folder.get\('parent'\)} | Folder: {folder.get\('folder_name'\)} | Append To: {folder.get\('append_to'\)}"\)
except Exception as e:
    print\(f"Error: {e}"\)

exit\(\)
EOF)
